# Iron Cross Welding & Fabrication

> Custom welding and metal fabrication in Orange County, California. LA City and AWS D1.1 certified. Fences, gates, trucks, trailers, heavy equipment, and 24/7 mobile welding.

Iron Cross Welding & Fabrication is based in Orange County, California, and also serves surrounding areas. It is a Christian-based business. Work is done in the shop and with a mobile welding rig. No street address is published.

## Contact

- Phone and text: (949) 329-3012
- Email: theironcrosswelding@gmail.com
- Shop hours: Monday to Saturday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Emergency mobile dispatch: 24/7
- Area: Orange County, CA and surrounding areas
- Usual reply time: the same day. Emergencies should call instead of waiting on email.

## What we weld

Serving Orange County and surrounding areas. Some jobs come to the shop, some need the crew on site.

Built in the shop:

- Fences
- Custom gates
- Truck flatbeds, winch bumpers, and racks
- Trailers and trailer repairs
- Railings, handrails, and stairs
- Custom steel fabrication
- Fire pits and one-off steel builds

Done on site, day or night:

- 24/7 mobile welding rig
- Heavy equipment
- Equipment repairs
- Farm and agricultural equipment
- Rust repair

If a job is not listed and it is steel, they will say whether they can do it.

## About

Built on faith and doing it right.

Iron Cross is a proud Christian-based business built on faith, honest work, and uncompromising integrity. Every project gets genuine pride in the workmanship, and every client is treated with respect and transparency.

The owner is LA City Certified and AWS D1.1 Structural Steel Certified, so welds are made to meet structural testing standards and inspection requirements.

Work includes automated driveway gates, security fences, heavy equipment repairs, truck flatbeds, and 24/7 emergency mobile welding. Jobs are built to take heavy use and made to last.

## Get a quote

Send the details and a few photos if you have them, or call and talk it through.

The quote form does not send email from the website and does not store the request. Submitting it opens the visitor's email app with a draft to theironcrosswelding@gmail.com. The draft subject is "Quote request:" plus the job type. The body includes name, phone, email, type of job, and project details.

The photo field does not attach files. A mailto link cannot carry attachments. If files were chosen, only their names are written into the draft as "Photos to attach:". The visitor has to attach those photos in the email app and send the message themselves.

Job types in the form:

- Fences and gates
- Truck, flatbed, or trailer
- Heavy or farm equipment
- Mobile on-site repair
- Railings, handrails, and stairs
- Custom fabrication
- Something else

Quote actions on the page: call now, or send a text to (949) 329-3012.
